text:
nina: opened PR to update Kestrel4b model card + migration guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210. Goals: replace a couple of external bucket links, clarify variant naming, and refresh SDK snippet for v4.

tariq: saw the preview. linkcheck flagged /assets/bench/kestrel/throughput.csv and an old storage.redwood.ai URL. we should move bench CSV into docs repo and swap the external weight link for a provenance note.

otto: the card's examples use both 'Kestrel-4B' and 'kestrel4b-int8' interchangeably. runtime aliasing confuses some clients. propose an "aliases" line and an explicit API pin example.

maya: SDK snippet shows sync client. new async model in SDK v4 uses awaitable generate. small snippet: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = await client.generate(model="kestrel-4b", prompt="Summarize: ...")
print(resp["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
```

link-bot: linkcheck: 2 broken links found (docs/model-sources.md#L9, /assets/bench/kestrel/throughput.csv). Recommendation: move bench assets to docs/assets/bench/kestrel and replace absolute weight URLs with provenance notes.

nina: i'll add a provenance block pointing to upstream repo + license and remove the absolute weight URL.

otto: adding YAML pin example for the migration guide: ```yaml
routes:
  - model: Kestrel-4B
    aliases: [kestrel4b, kestrel-4b-int8]
    pinned_variant: kestrel4b-int8
```

tariq: bench note: the throughput numbers were measured with a 100ms batch window. either re-run with our standard 200ms or add a clear methodology footnote. i'd prefer a footnote for now.

maya: updated the SDK snippet in the PR and left a TODO to add a streaming example later.

nina: samir-style checklist: 1) move CSV into docs/assets/bench/kestrel (tariq) 2) replace weight URL with provenance (nina) 3) merge SDK snippet update (maya) 4) normalize casing and aliases (otto).

tariq: pushed throughput.csv into docs/assets/bench/kestrel and updated links. CI running.

doc-bot: deploy-preview built. linkcheck shows 1 remaining external weight URL: https://storage.redwood.ai/models/kestrel/weights.tar.gz.

nina: removed the storage URL from model-sources.md and linked to the provenance paragraph in the card instead.

otto: normalized card text to use 'Kestrel-4B' display name and added an "aliases" line listing common runtime names. also added the YAML pin snippet.

maya: CI passed on snippet change. left a tiny nit about clarifying units in throughput table (tokens/sec).

tariq: updated methodology section: seq length 512, batch 8, batch window 100ms noted as footnote. left comment that we should re-run with 200ms later.

doc-bot: CI passed. linkcheck clean. preview: https://deployments.preview.redwood.ai/docs/kestrel-4b-card

nina: merging now. thanks all for fast help — will follow up with a short note to model-onboarding about adding alias guidance to the model card template.

otto: nice, thanks. will open a small follow-up to add streaming SDK examples next sprint.

nina: closing thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
